model_annotation: This plot illustrates the F1 score over epochs for three different methods: lattice, FLAT, and OURS. The x-axis, labeled “epoch (次)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 18, with tick labels indicating integer values from 0 to 18, spaced one unit apart. The y-axis, labeled “F1 分数”, also uses a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.55 to 0.90, with tick labels indicating values in increments of 0.05. The lattice line is represented by a red solid line, beginning at approximately 0.60 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 0.55 at epoch 4, then increasing to approximately 0.80 at epoch 12. The FLAT line is depicted as a blue solid line, starting at approximately 0.70 at epoch 0 and rising to approximately 0.85 at epoch 10, maintaining a relatively steady value until epoch 16, where it reaches approximately 0.85. The OURS line is shown as a green solid line, beginning at approximately 0.65 at epoch 0 and increasing to approximately 0.80 at epoch 8, then decreasing to approximately 0.75 at epoch 16.
